name: Voyager
summary: macOS file browser that finds your files and lets AI agents work with them as context, without a separate upload.
description: Voyager is an agentic file browser for macOS: you search and organize files in a familiar browser, then work with AI agents that use those files as context. The company says files are not uploaded to a separate store and are not sold for ads. Subscription costs for the AI providers you connect are paid to those providers.

pricing.details: Free; Early Supporter pass 179 € one-time; Plus and Pro coming soon.
pricing.label: Freemium
